{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, indicating systematic undershoot that corrects toward the mean over time",
    "The gap between model forecasts and true outcomes increases with sentiment positivity, showing sentiment amplifies forecast lag",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model forecasts remain elevated relative to reality, creating 2-3 day overshoot lag",
    "Mean reversion is evident in both forecasts and outcomes, but forecasts lag behind true price mean reversion by approximately 3-5 days",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to negative causes the largest forecast errors as models maintain prior bullish assumptions",
    "Model volatility is consistently lower than true outcome volatility, missing market price swings",
    "Forecasts fail to fully capture the magnitude of sentiment-driven price movements, especially at trend inflection points"
] }
